name: Search input
summary: Search field with an icon, a clear button and an optional shortcut hint. The label is visually hidden by default, but always there for screen readers.
use: Search in a list, a table or the whole app.
avoid: Normal text input in a form: use Input.
Moving between pages and actions: use Command menu.
anatomy: Clear button (shows as soon as there is a value).
Shortcut hint (Kbd, only when the field is empty).
figmaProps: Filled shows the clear button and hides the shortcut.
reactProps: onChange gets the string, not the event.
Only the hint. The app handles the shortcut itself.
behaviour: Escape clears the field when it has a value.
The clear button moves focus back into the field.
a11y: Put the field in <form role="search"> so it is a search landmark.
Announce the number of results in a live region when the list filters as you type.
content: The placeholder says what you search in: "Search projects".
do: Show results straight away, or after Enter, but always the same way.
dont: A search field without a label, even if the icon seems clear.
